audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Mordekaiser rows 2-6 while the win rate is 53.01% over 3322 games and the mirror settled a different chart.
audit.why: mordekaiser__sett was audited first and fixed to Sett / Skill / Sett / Sett / Mordekaiser / Sett / Skill. The two directions must match.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs with ratings; rows 0, 1 and 4 already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named a non-existent ability, 'Darkness Rises', and the level-6 why line was labelled level 5.
audit.why: Riot's name is Darkness Rise, and it turns on after 3 attacks or spells hit a champion or monster. The level-6 swing is Realm of Death (140/120/100s), not a level-5 passive shift.
audit.corrected: Name fixed and the spike now states the three-hit trigger; whys[4] retargeted to level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible was never stated, so the page had no anti-heal or shield-baiting advice.
audit.why: Indestructible (W, 12/11/10/9/8s) stores damage he deals AND takes into a shield he can consume to heal — every auto you sink into him funds it. Grievous Wounds timing is the decisive item call, and the itemization block already buys Executioner's without saying why in the trade text.
audit.corrected: spikes[2] now names Indestructible, its cooldown, and the Executioner's timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Death's Grasp listed with no range or cooldown.
audit.why: It is a 700-range delayed pull on 16/14/12/10/8s — the number is what makes 'sidestep it' actionable.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries range and rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Level 5 tips to Morde as passive uptime and E win drawn-out trades.
edits.after: Level 6 tips to Morde — Realm of Death strips your team from the duel.

edits.before: At 2+ items Morde's omnivamp and R isolation win extended 1v1s.
edits.after: At 2+ items it's skill: his omnivamp against your max-grit Haymaker.

edits.before: Before Morde has his passive rolling you win trades — E Facebreaker into Q-W punishes him, and disengage before he can stack Darkness Rises on you.
edits.after: Before Darkness Rise is rolling you win trades — Facebreaker into Q-W punishes him, and step out before three hits switch his damage aura on.

edits.before: Grit trades tip back your way — your W Haymaker plus sustain out-duels his pre-Riftmaker body once you avoid eating full E Death's Grasp pulls.
edits.after: Grit trades tip back your way, but Indestructible (W, 12s) banks your damage into a shield he eats for health — buy Executioner's before you commit.

edits.before: Stack Darkness Rises passive in extended trades
edits.after: Stack Darkness Rise passive in extended trades

edits.before: You win level 1-2: Morde's power comes from stacking his Darkness Rises passive over long fights, so keep trades short — Q Knuckle Down, auto, and disengage before the AoE ramps. Pit Grit sustain keeps you healthy through his early poke.
edits.after: You win level 1-2: Darkness Rise switches on after three hits land on you, so keep trades short — Q Knuckle Down, double-punch, and step out before the aura ramps. Your missing-health regen keeps you healthy through his poke.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — His 1v1 realm. Burst him fast inside it. Track it before every engage. - Mordekaiser Death’s Grasp: Pulls enemies toward him after a delay + passive magic pen. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — 140s at rank 1. His 1v1 realm; burst him fast inside it. - Mordekaiser Death’s Grasp (E, 16s at rank 1): a 700-range pull that lands after a delay. Sidestep the ring.

edits.before: Mordekaiser wastes Realm of Death — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads plus MR blunt his aura; commit once his W shield is spent.

notes: champ-data/_kits/mordekaiser.json marks Obliterate (Q) with a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's own description is only a ground smash that damages each enemy struck, increased against a single target — no dash-block is stated. Treated as a tooltip-parse misfire and not written to the page (the mirror audit flagged the same thing). Whether Sett's The Show Stopper can pull Mordekaiser out of, or be used inside, Realm of Death is not answerable from the kit text, so no claim was made — logged in unverified.
